card.statement:
For any $\mathscr{F}$ in $D^{\mathrm{b}}_{c,{G_{\mathcal{O}}}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathbf{k})$ , the following conditions are equivalent:

1.

$\mathscr{F}$ is a perverse sheaf

2.

for any $\mu\in X_{*}(T)$ and $k\in\mathbf{Z}$ we have

$\mathsf{H}_{c}^{k}(S_{\mu},\mathscr{F})\neq 0\quad\Rightarrow\quad k=\langle 2\rho,\mu\rangle.$

3.

for any $\mu\in X_{*}(T)$ and $k\in\mathbf{Z}$ we have

$\mathsf{H}^{k}_{S_{\mu}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathscr{F})\neq 0\quad\Rightarrow\quad k=-\langle 2\rho,\mu\rangle.$
card.label: Lemma 10.6

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
